paragraph: J'Koby Williams has run for 1,195 yards and 9 touchdowns this season. On Thursday, 5-6 TCU visits 10-1 No. 9 Texas Tech in Texas. Both teams are eager for a big win! A win sends Texas Tech back to the Big 12 Championship Game. TCU needs a win to play in a bowl game. Watch Williams run with the ball!

paragraph: Florida State needs 1 more win to reach 6! On Friday, the 5-6 Seminoles host the 7-4 No. 20 Florida Gators in Tallahassee. Florida has won 2 games in a row. Watch Ashton Daniels: He has 2,309 passing yards and 14 touchdowns. A win would lift Florida State to 6-6 in the standings!

paragraph: Ready for a Texas clash? On Friday, No. 5 Texas Longhorns visit the Texas A&M Aggies in Texas. Texas is 9-2, and Texas A&M is 4-7. This is the last regular-season game for both teams! Watch Arch Manning: He has 2,485 passing yards and 21 TDs. Texas has won 5 straight.

paragraph: 17 wins in a row for Utah! On Friday, 5-6 West Virginia visits No. 2 Utah in Utah. The Utes are 11-0 and have a spot in the Big 12 Championship Game. paragraph: On Saturday, Nov 28, football comes to Syracuse, New York. No. 3 Notre Dame is 10-1, and Syracuse is 5-6. Notre Dame’s CJ Carr has 2,697 passing yards and 24 touchdowns! paragraph: Boston College beat Syracuse 27-15 in its last game. On Saturday, the 5-6 Eagles visit No. 4 Miami in Florida. The 10-1 Hurricanes have won 12 ACC games in a row! Miami's Darian Mensah has 3,317 passing yards and 29 touchdowns this season. Miami has a spot in the ACC championship game. Boston College has a chance to reach a bowl with a win.

paragraph: No. 18 Louisville heads to Kentucky with an 8-3 record. The Kentucky Wildcats are 7-4. The rivals play for the Governor’s Cup on Saturday! Louisville’s Isaac Brown has run for 804 yards and 8 touchdowns. Can Kentucky’s Kenny Darby add to his 711 receiving yards?

paragraph: Gunner Stockton has 2,390 passing yards and 22 TDs this season. On Saturday, 3-8 Georgia Tech visits 10-1 No. 1 Georgia in Georgia. This is Georgia’s last regular-season game before the SEC Championship Game. Watch Stockton shine when he throws!

paragraph: A spot in the Big Ten title game is at stake! On Saturday, No. 10 UCLA (10-1) hosts No. 15 USC (8-3) in California. paragraph: Ready for a thrilling ACC race? On Saturday, 7-4 Duke visits No. 8 Wake Forest, 10-1, in North Carolina. Duke’s Nate Sheppard has 1,436 rushing yards and 20 rushing TDs. paragraph: 1,215 rushing yards belong to Tennessee’s DeSean Bishop this season! On Saturday, No. 7 Tennessee (9-2) plays Vanderbilt (4-7) in Tennessee. paragraph: On Saturday, Nov. 28, Auburn visits Alabama! The Tigers are 7-4, and No. 6 Alabama is 9-2. Auburn’s Byrum Brown has 2,035 passing yards and 15 TDs.
